messages:
Aila G.: FYI noticed p95 on /v1/generate jumped ~2x around the routing policy deploy at 09:12 UTC
Tim K.: yeah saw that in eu-west only, us-east looks fine :confused:
Aila G.: looks correlated with fallback to model-quantized-v2 after the pool rebalancer moved traffic
obs-bot: alert: metric p95_latency_ms /service=generate /region=eu-west > 300 for 3m
Jay P.: can we get the raw sample counts? suspect low-sample amplification on p95 aggregator
Maria S.: pulling dashboard -> cohort breakdown now. quick query I used:```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{endpoint="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, route, region))
```
Tim K.: that matches the UI calc. but the console shows p99s also moving, odd since only p95 alert fired
Aila G.: UI uses tdigest rollup; on route merge we have sample-weight differences vs the raw histogram query
Jay P.: ah — when routing policy adds fallback weights we previously normalized by total route weight; the rollup code accidentally normalized by route count instead
Maria S.: repro snippet I ran locally:```json
{"routes": [{"name":"primary","weight":70},{"name":"fallback","weight":30}], "samples": [ ... ]}
```
Maria S.: with the bug p95 gets biased high when fallback has lower QPS but heavier tail
Tim K.: so in eu-west fallback was used more because of transient capacity shortage -> few heavy samples dominated percentile
Aila G.: proposed fix: change rollup normalization to use weighted sample counts and prefer merging via tdigest.merge_with_weights(). low-cost hotfix for console only?
Jay P.: agree do console fix then pipeline fix in telemetry ingestion. add unit test for route-weighted merge edge case
Maria S.: will open PR to console: small change + test, call it "route-weighted-tdigest-merge"
Aila G.: can someone add a temporary note on the dashboard to explain potential route-weight bias while we patch? worried oncalls will get noisy alerts
Tim K.: I'll add an annotation and lower eu-west p95 alert sensitivity until we confirm fix in staging
obs-bot: deploy started: console-pr-428 on staging by Maria S.
Maria S.: deployed to staging, running synthetic checks (qps spike + fallback scenario)
Maria S.: staging results: synthetic showed p95 aligned with raw histogram now, p99 unaffected as expected
Jay P.: nice. schedule rollback window for prod push? don't want new noise during peak tomorrow
Aila G.: propose 01:00 UTC window, Maria can you coordinate with releases team
Maria S.: yep, filing release runbook and pinging releases channel. will also attach a short explainer blurb for oncall playbook
Tim K.: thanks all. after prod deploy let's run a backfill compare: console p95 vs histogram p95 across endpoints for 24h
Aila G.: good idea — will script it. low-priority follow-up: consider surfacing sample-counts per-route in the UI to make these cases obvious
Jay P.: +1, that would've saved us some debugging time
Aila G.: ok closing here for now, tracked in GH issue #1842. :white_check_mark:
